features: Screen size: Enjoy a premium home theater experience with the smart ZEB-Pixaplay 67 projector, offering up to 381 cm(150 inches) projection and a 200° tilt for versatile, large-screen viewing.
Brightness: The projector features a high-brightness LED lamp with a whooping 9000 lumens and supports 1080p FHD native resolution and 4K support, delivering clear, detailed content on large screens.
Built-in speaker: Enjoy nonstop movie marathons with the ZEB-Pixaplay 67, which features a powerful speaker for fantastic audio.
Lifelong LED lamp: With a 50,000-hour lamp life, the ZEB-Pixaplay 67 offers endless projection at home.
Multi-connectivity: This projector offers connectivity options for BT v5.2, HDMI, AV IN, RJ45, USB port, and AUX OUT.
